entities.name: PMID:25446597
observations: In wounded IEC-6 cells, Atractylodes macrocephala extract increased polyamine content and restored DFMO-suppressed migration to control levels; abstract gives no effect sizes.

entities.name: PMID:24417867
observations: Related study reports AMK-mediated intestinal epithelial restitution via a polyamine–voltage-gated K+ channel pathway in IEC-6 wound assays.

entities.name: AMK polyamine migration
observations: In IEC-6 wound assays, Atractylodes macrocephala extract increased cellular polyamines and countered DFMO-associated migration suppression; direct support for polyamine dependence, but the available abstract omits effect sizes and detailed rescue outcomes.
